Name: Seasonal Head Flowers
Author: StarryGoldfish
Description:
[size=4][font=Verdana][b]Description[/b][/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana](つ｡˃ ᵕ ˂)つ 𖡼.𖤣𖥧𖡼.𖤣𖥧[/font][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][font=Verdana][b]Seasonal Head Flowers[/b] adds a little animated flower that grows right out of your farmer's head and changes with the seasons![/font][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][font=Verdana]
🌷 [b]Spring:[/b] Lavender, Yellow, or Red Tulip
🌻 [b]Summer:[/b] Sunflower
🌸 [b]Fall:[/b] Pink, Cyan, Lavender, or Salmon Fairy Rose
❄️ [b]Winter:[/b] Crocus[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][font=Verdana]
Spring and Fall flower colors can be selected through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][font=Verdana]
Because life is better with a parasitic flower growing from your skull[/font][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=5][font=Verdana] (*ᴗ͈ ˬᴗ͈)ꕤ*.ﾟ[/font][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=Verdana][b]Installation instructions[/b][/font][/size]

[list=1]
[*][font=Verdana]Install SMAPI. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Download Seasonal Head Flowers. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Unzip the downloaded file. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Place the [b]SeasonalHeadFlowers[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][b]Optional:[/b] Install Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to easily choose your Spring and Fall flower colors through the in-game [b]Configure Mods[/b] menu.[/font]

[size=4][font=Verdana][b]Main features[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]Live your best farmer life with a plant? idk[/color][/font][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][font=Verdana][b]Required[/b]
[/font][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Verdana][b]SMAPI[/b] — Required to run Seasonal Head Flowers. [/font][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][font=Verdana][b]Optional (but reccomended)[/b][/font][/color]
[list]

[/list]
